The variable `file` is created at line 13 using `name`, and `name` is computed at line 11 using `root` (through `getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName())`). Since `root` is used as an argument to `getUnrootedName()` which is then used to compute `name`, and `name` is used to create `file`, the value of `file` at line 34 does depend on the value of `root` at line 3.
